name: Bajirao I
role: Peshwa of the Maratha Empire from 1720 to 1740
contribution: General of the Maratha Empire in India (1700-1740).
legacy: After the death of Balaji, he was proclaimed Peshwa and over the new two decades he led the Maratha army on an unprecedented campaign of expansion, conquering Mughal territory up till Delhi and Cuttack

checks.lead: Bajirao I (born Visaji, Marathi: [ˈbaːdʑiɾaːʋ bəˈlːaːɭ̆]; 18 August 1700 – 28 April 1740) was the 7th Peshwa of the Maratha Empire.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
